english.title: Carry on prescribed process without complying with conditions of a granted authorisation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) carried on a prescribed process, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROCESS..), after the date prescribed or determined for that description of process by or under regulations under section 2(1) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 otherwise than in accordance with the conditions to which it was subject
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 6(1) and 23(1)(a) and (2) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 1(5) defines 'process' as any activities carried on in Great Britain, whether on premises or by means of mobile plant, which are capable of causing pollution of the environment and 'prescribed process' means a process prescribed under section 2(1).
(ii) Section 1(9) defines 'authorisation' as an authorisation for a process (whether on premises or by means of mobile plant) granted under section 6 below; and a reference to the conditions of an authorisation is a reference to the conditions subject to which at any time the authorisation has effect.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding twenty thousand pounds
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
